description: Versioned, machine-readable definitions of Azure MCP Server performance workloads and the controlled-environment and statistical rules they run under (issue #3120). Bump catalog_version and record the reason whenever a workload definition changes, since a change can shift baselines.

environment_requirements.runner: Dedicated or sufficiently isolated runner. Baseline-quality runs must not share the host with other CI work; developer laptops are for exploration only.
environment_requirements.runtime: The .NET SDK pinned by global.json; record the exact runtime in each result's environment block.
environment_requirements.network: Loopback only for server-overhead workloads. The measured path must exclude Azure and network time (deterministic no-op / tools/list).
environment_requirements.configuration: Server launched with the documented args per workload; no unrelated environment variables set.

statistical_rules.warmup: Every scenario performs warm-up iterations that are discarded before measurement.
statistical_rules.comparison: Compare current vs approved baseline as ratios. Changes below 5% are ignored, changes above 5% warn, and budget breaches block. Prefer median/percentiles over the mean for latency.
statistical_rules.notes: Micro-benchmarks additionally report BenchmarkDotNet StdDev / confidence intervals; the host environment (OS, CPU, runtime) is captured in the BenchmarkDotNet report header.
